purpose: Declared, attributed drift entries for release/prepaper_release_manifest.json. This file is NOT under release/ and is not bound by any manifest, so registering an entry here never creates a new drift. Read by scripts/verify_release_chain_with_dispositions.py.

policy.fail_closed: Any hash mismatch that is not registered here is reported as DRIFT_UNREGISTERED and makes the verifier exit non-zero.
policy.no_history_rewrite: Registering an entry does not modify release/ or data/. The owner still has to choose a re-pin or a supersession in release/.
